svg.text: Speed limiter through the brake line: breadboard layout (top view)

g.text: both white wires join in column 15

svg.text: to BRAKE wire that reads 5 V
The two white wires meet in column 15, so the speed signal passes straight through. The chip only listens to it, through the 1 kΩ resistor.
The optional 100 nF capacitor from pin 7 to ground, with the 1 kΩ, filters short noise spikes before they reach the chip.
Motor red/black are the controller's own 5 V and GND and power the board. Leave the brake lever connected. All "−" rails are one ground.
